**I. Preparation & Initial Records (Following "Start with the Inspection Records")**

1. **Verify Inspection Records:** Before *any* brake testing, confirm the vehicle's maintenance history. Look for recent brake work (pads, rotors, lines, master cylinder, etc.). Note any previous brake-related issues reported. This context can help diagnose the current failure.
2. **Vehicle Information:**  Double-check you have accurate vehicle identification (VIN, make, model, year). This is crucial for legal and reporting purposes.
